newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Etex does not rule out eventual listing.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Etex does not rule out eventual listing.

text.p: Belgian building materials group Etex, one of the country's largest private companies, does not rule out an eventual stock market listing, according to an interview in L'Echo newspaper published on Tuesday.

"I would not surprise you by saying we don't envisage seeking a quotation in the near term, however this is not to exclude one in the medium-term, that is in around five years," Etex communications director Paul van der Straten Waillet was quoted as saying.
Etex had 1996 sales of 67.1 billion Belgian francs and made a net current profit of around 5.2 billion francs.
